body_combined_text:
__Oscar Piastri topped the times in Free Practice 2 for the Japanese Grand Prix, beating Mercedes drivers Kimi Antonelli and George Russell.__

The Australian [posted a 1m 30.133s using Pirelli's soft tyre](https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/fp2-piastri-sets-the-pace-from-antonelli-and-russell-during-second-practice.2CeFTkESJX45t8tlF1V0rm), which left him 0.092s clear of Antonelli and a further tenth faster than Russell at the Suzuka Circuit.

Lando Norris was half a second away from his team mate but the reigning World Champion missed the first half of the one-hour session as McLaren investigated a hydraulic leak, with the top six completed by Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton.
